URL: https://www.catonetworks.com

# About Cato Networks
Cato pioneered the convergence of networking and security into the cloud. Aligned with Gartner’s Secure Access Service Edge (SASE) frameworks, Cato’s vision is to deliver a next generation IT security platform that eliminates the complexity, costs, and risks associated with legacy IT approaches based on disjointed point solutions.

/* airfleet-nexus:css:nexus-solution-pages-fixes */
/* Parity fixes vs the live agent_page originals. Separate handle so the main
   nexus-solution-pages region is never rewritten. All rules .nexus-sol scoped:
   live pages are the agent_page CPT and carry no such class, so they cannot match. */

/* A. Marketo required-field asterisk. Marketo injects .mktoAsterix at runtime, so no
   block attribute can reach it. Live hides it: .mktoForm .mktoAsterix{display:none!important} */
.nexus-sol .mktoForm .mktoAsterix{display:none!important}

/* E. What's-new thumbnail treatment. The nexus thumb is a core/group carrying the artwork as a
   background image; the live .fa-res__thumb adds two decorative layers that have no block
   equivalent (a pseudo-element cannot be authored as an attribute). Values copied verbatim
   from the live rules. */
.nexus-sol .js-res-card>.wp-block-group:first-child{position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.nexus-sol .js-res-card>.wp-block-group:first-child::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:0;pointer-events:none;background:radial-gradient(120% 92% at 82% 130%, rgba(129,229,172,.32), transparent 55%),repeating-radial-gradient(circle at 82% 128%, rgba(255,255,255,.07) 0, rgba(255,255,255,.07) 1px, transparent 1px, transparent 24px)}
.nexus-sol .js-res-card>.wp-block-group:first-child::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;height:62%;z-index:2;pointer-events:none;background:linear-gradient(to top, rgba(13,31,28,.55), transparent)}
.nexus-sol .js-res-card>.wp-block-group:first-child>*{position:relative;z-index:3}

/* F. Today's-challenges "done" state. Live has three label states -- active #FFFFFF,
   already-played rgba(255,255,255,.72) via .fa-chal__seg.is-done, and untouched
   rgba(255,255,255,.45). The nexus page runtime only implements two: it writes the label
   colour inline as on/off, so played segments drop back to .45 instead of staying lit.
   The runtime does mark a played segment by setting its fill to an inline width:100%
   (the active one is animated via WAAPI and keeps width:0%), so the done state can be
   selected without touching the 16.8KB runtime. !important is required because the
   runtime writes the colour inline. */
.nexus-sol .js-chal-seg:has(.js-chal-segfill[style*="width: 100%"]) p{color:rgba(255,255,255,.72)!important}

/* C. Hero CTA buttons sit on one row on live because .btn carries white-space:nowrap, which
   keeps each label on a single line (54px tall). core/button exposes no white-space attribute,
   so the block layout can be set to nowrap natively but the label still wraps to 75px without
   this. Scoped to the hero rows whose layout.flexWrap was set to nowrap.
   DESKTOP ONLY: below the 880px breakpoint the same rule pushed a 100%-wide button past the
   viewport edge, so it stops at 881px. */
@media (min-width:881px){.nexus-sol .js-band-hero .wp-block-buttons.is-nowrap .wp-block-button__link{white-space:nowrap}}

/* D. Mobile hero CTAs must stack. The shared mobile rules already give every hero button
   width:100%, but a row whose layout.flexWrap is "nowrap" keeps both on one line, so the two
   full-width buttons shrink and the row runs past the viewport. Only the four heroes that
   carry .is-nowrap are affected; the wrapping heroes already stack. Inside the same 880px
   breakpoint the rest of the mobile rules use, so nothing above it changes. */
@media (max-width:880px){.nexus-sol .js-band-hero .wp-block-buttons.is-nowrap{flex-wrap:wrap!important}}
